# Security Policy

## Scope

This repository contains analytical code for research purposes. It does not include:

- Web applications or APIs
- User authentication systems
- Database connections with credentials
- Executable software for end users

## Reporting Critical Issues

While this repository has no active maintenance (see [SUPPORT.md](SUPPORT.md)), we may review reports of:

### Methodological Errors

Errors in calculations or statistical models that could affect the validity of published results.

### Data Privacy Concerns

Inadvertent exposure of personally identifiable information (PII) or sensitive data.

Do not open a public GitHub issue for data privacy concerns.

## How to Report

Email: [info@azahardata.com](mailto:info@azahardata.com)  
Subject line: `[CRITICAL] New Seed Framework`

Include:

- Description of the issue
- Location in the code (script name, line numbers)
- Potential impact
- Suggested correction (if any)

## No Guaranteed Response

There is no commitment to respond to community inquiries. However, critical issues affecting scientific validity or data privacy are more likely to receive attention.

## Versions

Only the latest release may receive attention for critical issues. Previous releases are archived for reproducibility but will not be updated.
